verdict.rationale: A state business-filing authority could plausibly document registered agents or authorized filers, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing every host disallows crawling, and none of them document a sanctioned third-party rail such as registered agents, designees or authorized providers.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
